content.user_title: Search and Crawl the Web with Tavily
content.value_statement: Finding current web information and usable page content can require many manual searches. This skill helps Claude query Tavily, extract URL content, and crawl sites in a focused research workflow.
actual_capabilities: Searches the web for current information through Tavily.
Extracts readable content from supplied URLs.
Crawls websites for related pages and research material.
Supports research workflows in Claude Code conversations.
Uses a configured Tavily API key for service access.
limitations: Requires a Tavily account and configured API key.
Search and extraction quality depends on Tavily coverage and source pages.
Does not replace source verification or expert review.
Does not provide unrestricted browsing beyond its documented scope.

use_cases.title: Investigate a Current Topic
use_cases.description: Search recent sources, compare findings, and collect citations for a research brief.

use_cases.title: Extract Documentation Content
use_cases.description: Provide documentation URLs and retrieve focused page content for a technical answer.

use_cases.title: Map a Website
use_cases.description: Crawl a permitted site to discover related pages and organize material for a content audit.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Find Recent Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the web for three recent, reliable sources about [topic]. Summarize each source and include its URL.

prompt_templates.title: Extract a Web Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the main content from [URL]. Summarize the key points and identify any missing context.
prompt_templates.scenario: Reviewing one article or documentation page

prompt_templates.title: Compare Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for authoritative sources about [question], extract relevant passages, and compare agreements, conflicts, and publication dates.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Crawl a Site
prompt_templates.prompt: Crawl [permitted domain] for pages related to [topic]. Return a structured reading list with page titles, URLs, relevance, and duplicate topics.

output_examples.input: Find recent sources about browser privacy standards.
output_examples.output: A concise source list with publication dates, key findings, URLs, and notes about source reliability.

output_examples.input: Extract the main points from a product documentation URL.
output_examples.output: A focused summary of the page, including important terms, configuration details, and unresolved questions.

output_examples.input: Crawl a permitted documentation site for authentication guides.

best_practices: State the research question, date range, and preferred source types.
Use only URLs and domains you are authorized to access.
Verify important claims against the original source before publication.
anti_patterns: Do not treat one search result as definitive evidence.
Do not crawl private or restricted websites without permission.
Do not submit sensitive information in search queries or extracted content requests.

faq.question: What service does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses the Tavily API for web search, URL content extraction, and website crawling.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Install the skill and configure a valid Tavily API key before using it.

faq.question: Can it search for current information?
faq.answer: Yes. It is intended for web research where current information is needed.

faq.question: Can it read a specific URL?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an accessible URL when you want content extracted and summarized.

faq.question: Can it crawl any website?
faq.answer: Use it only on sites you are permitted to access, and follow applicable terms and policies.

faq.question: Should I verify its results?
faq.answer: Yes. Verify important claims with original sources because coverage and extraction quality can vary.
